comment: The scope recently viewed/compared product lists are tracked across.
modal: Sets whether recently viewed and compared products are tracked per **Website**, **Store**, or **Store View**. Can be set per website.

comment: The number of products shown in the Recently Viewed block.
modal: The maximum number of items displayed in the Recently Viewed Products block. Can differ per store view.

comment: The number of products shown in the Recently Compared block.
modal: The maximum number of items displayed in the Recently Compared Products block. Can differ per store view.

comment: The month and day the admin dashboard's Year-To-Date period begins.
modal: Sets the start month and day used for Year-To-Date totals shown on the admin dashboard.
